# NET-008: ufw-docker is not paired with Docker's nftables backend

- **Group:** Firewall and exposure
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

ufw-docker works by filtering the iptables DOCKER-USER chain. Docker's nftables firewall backend creates no DOCKER-USER chain, so ufw-docker then filters nothing while looking installed.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo nft list tables | grep docker; grep firewall-backend /etc/docker/daemon.json
```

## How to fix it

Use Docker's iptables backend with ufw-docker, or filter published ports directly in nftables

## What a fix can break

Changing Docker's firewall backend needs a Docker restart and rebuilds every container network rule.

Run `stackward explain NET-008` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
